_: What each landmass of the painted map looks like (owner 2026-10-11) – scripts/map-paint.mjs puts the zones of a region into its prompt. `at` = a point on the island (world units; the landmass under it), `rect` = every landmass whose middle lies inside and that no `at` zone took. Land in no zone gets a season of its own (random, fixed per island). The numbers: logs/map-paint/zones-sheet.png (scripts/map-zones.mjs).

zones.name: desert
zones.look: an alien DOOM-planet desert (African dunes on another world): one continuous sea of glowing dunes drifting from tangerine into hot magenta, violet and turquoise sands, cracked salt pans in neon pink, scorched black rock ridges with glowing veins

zones.name: altiplano
zones.look: a high steppe like the Peruvian altiplano: waves of golden grass shading into lime, coral and lavender, low rounded mountain ranges in banded rainbow strata (like Vinicunca, the Rainbow Mountain), turquoise mineral lagoons

zones.name: alps
zones.look: the Alps in deep WINTER (always winter here): snow and ice in electric cyan, lilac, mint and pearl, sharp glittering ridges, glacier swirls, frosted crystal fields glowing from within

zones.name: jungle
zones.look: a REPTILE world of dense primeval JUNGLE: canopy textures in emerald, acid green and teal, iridescent lizard-scale patterns in gold and violet, steaming swamp pools in electric blue

zones.name: wasteland
zones.look: a toxic WASTELAND – a post-industrial nuclear disaster zone scarred by fracking: cracked crusts in sulphur yellow, radioactive green glow, rust orange, oily black pools with rainbow sheen, slag in hot pink

zones.name: mountains
zones.island: the long island east of the island world (Bergdorf, Bergpfad, Kloster, Erzberg) – owner 2026-10-12: "this is also mountainous – changing from lowlands to the mountains; this is what I meant with huge mountains"
zones.look: a long island that rises from LOWLANDS into HUGE MOUNTAINS: in the north lush rolling lowlands (meadows, fields and forest canopy in emerald, lime and turquoise), climbing south through foothills and deep valleys into a massive range of towering, dramatic peaks – sharp ridges, glaciers and snowy summits in pearl, lilac and electric cyan, rust-red and copper ore slopes on the mountainsides; strong relief, the biggest mountains of the world map

zones.name: archipelago
zones.look: an island world – NOT a city: every small island its own jewel-like crazy texture in candy and jewel colours (opal, malachite, rose quartz, lapis, glowing lava, iridescent shell)

seasons: in SPRING: blossom pinks, fresh lime and mint, wet glossy earth in violet
in SUMMER: blazing gold, coral and turquoise, sun-baked glowing stone
in AUTUMN: flaming crimson, amber and plum, glowing leaf-litter textures
in WINTER: frost in electric cyan, lilac and silver, glittering snow crust
